name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you take a fundamental step toward communion with the elemental spirits. You move from earth and fire toward water's fluidity and purity.
As a dwarf, you hear a mentor's gruff cadence as you follow rugged mountain paths toward communion with nature.

faq.answer: Call of Water begins a shaman's communion with water. Having learned from earth, wind, and fire, the initiate now seeks water's deeper truth.
faq.q: What is the Call of Water?

aliases: who says the mountain waits for no one
faq.answer: Eldrun Stormbreaker, the shaman trainer in Ironforge, sends the initiate to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. Norric urges a decisive first step, for neither the elements nor the heights wait for hesitation.
faq.q: Who guides this step of the journey?

aliases: what does mountain waits for no one mean
the mountain waits for no one
faq.answer: The saying urges the initiate to begin a demanding ascent. Shamanic journeys lead into high peaks and remote wilderness where the spirits dwell, and they call for resolve.
faq.q: What does it mean that the mountain waits for no one?

faq.answer: Water teaches cleansing, fluidity, and purity. Stone offers stability and fire fuels resolve, while water's wisdom helps balance the spirits within oneself.
faq.q: What is the truth of water's purity?

faq.answer: Earth, wind, and fire are foundations the initiate has already felt in boot, breath, and belly. Harmony calls for balance among the elements, not pursuit of one power alone.
faq.q: How does water relate to the other elements here?

aliases: what happens next call of water
faq.answer: Norric Lochthane sends the initiate to the Wetlands to seek the water sapta from Hervdana Saegrund. She dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.
faq.q: Where does the initiate go after hearing these words?

sections.body: A shaman who has found balance with earth, wind, and flame now turns to water. Its lesson reaches beyond a force to wield. Water offers a spiritual image of purity and resilience.
sections.title: The Path of Purity

sections.body: Norric Lochthane urges the initiate onward without delay. Communion with the elements demands effort and endurance, and the way climbs through rugged country. The mountain waits for no one. Understanding begins with the ascent.
sections.title: Ascent into the Elements

summary: In Loch Modan, Norric Lochthane calls a shaman toward water's purity. Having found harmony with wind, earth, and flame, the initiate is ready to commune with water.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Water
